skill.name: ecommerce-detail-copywriter
skill.description: Draft product detail pages and purchase FAQs from supplied facts or supported Douyin and Xiaohongshu product data through SocialDataX.
skill.summary: Turn verified product facts into structured sales copy, purchase FAQs, source notes, and missing information lists.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: One finding is confirmed: the CLI examples execute an unpinned npm package with automatic confirmation, creating supply-chain exposure. The remaining 36 findings reflect Markdown delimiters, ordinary service URLs, credential configuration references, product identifiers, or readable multilingual text. No evidence found of credential exfiltration, concealed payloads, or prompt injection in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Online examples run socialdatax-skills@latest through npx -y without a fixed reviewed version.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version and use a lockfile with integrity verification; require approval before initial installation or updates.

content.user_title: Write Product Detail Pages and Purchase FAQs
content.value_statement: Scattered product facts make clear sales copy difficult to prepare. This skill organizes supplied facts or supported product data into structured copy and purchase FAQs.
actual_capabilities: Draft opening headlines, supporting copy, selling points, usage scenarios, specifications, and purchase FAQs.
Work directly from supplied product facts without requiring an API key.
Guide Douyin and Xiaohongshu product lookups through SocialDataX CLI commands or corresponding configured MCP tools.
Reference up to three comparable products when explicitly requested, with at most two additional detail checks.
Separate supported facts from suggested wording, record sources, and flag missing or conflicting information.
Adapt drafts to the requested audience, platform, tone, and length.
limitations: Online retrieval supports only Douyin and Xiaohongshu products; other platforms require supplied product facts.
Online CLI calls require Node.js, npm, a SocialDataX API key, and sufficient provider balance.
The skill cannot independently verify certifications, performance claims, changing prices, or missing policies.
It does not publish listings or modify accounts; online examples execute an external npm package using a mutable latest version.

use_cases.title: Prepare a first product listing
use_cases.description: Turn a merchant's product specifications into structured detail copy and purchase FAQs while listing missing facts separately.

use_cases.title: Refresh an existing product page
use_cases.description: Rewrite supplied product information for a defined audience and tone without adding unsupported benefits or policy claims.

use_cases.title: Develop evidence-based product positioning
use_cases.description: Compare a target product with a small, explicitly requested sample of supported marketplace products to improve structure without copying claims.

prompt_templates.title: Draft from basic facts
prompt_templates.prompt: Write detail copy for a 500 ml stainless steel screw-top flask for commuters. Include purchase FAQs and missing facts. Do not invent heat-retention duration.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: create a first draft without online retrieval.

prompt_templates.title: Revise supplied copy
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite [current copy] using [verified product facts] for [audience] in a [tone] voice. Preserve price conditions and flag unsupported claims.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: improve an existing listing using supplied evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Use a supported product link
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this [Douyin or Xiaohongshu product URL] to draft detail copy for [audience]. Include source and query time. Flag missing specifications. Do not search competitors.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: retrieve one product after configuring the online prerequisites.

prompt_templates.title: Compare a limited reference sample
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft copy from [target product facts]. Search one page on [Douyin or Xiaohongshu]. Reference at most three comparable products and check at most two details. Preserve source notes. Flag conflicting facts. Never transfer competitor claims.
prompt_templates.scenario: Expert: combine bounded competitor research with evidence-based drafting.

output_examples.input: Draft copy for commuters from these supplied facts: a 500 ml stainless steel flask with a screw-top lid.
output: Headline: A 500 ml flask for your commute
Supporting copy: A stainless steel flask with a screw-top lid for your daily routine.
Specifications: Capacity: 500 ml. Material: stainless steel. Closure: screw-top lid.
FAQ: What is the capacity? The flask holds 500 ml.
Source: User-provided facts. Confirm dimensions, cleaning guidance, and heat-retention performance before adding those details.

output_examples.input: Rewrite a cotton tote listing for students. Supplied facts: 38 by 42 cm, one main compartment, black. Delivery and returns are unknown.
output: Headline: A black cotton tote for student routines
Supporting copy: A simple cotton tote with one main compartment.
Specifications: Size: 38 by 42 cm. Material: cotton. Color: black.
FAQ: Does it have separate compartments? The supplied specifications list one main compartment.
Source: User-provided facts. Confirm delivery, returns, care instructions, and load capacity before publication.

best_practices: Provide verified specifications, intended audience, tone, and complete price or promotion conditions.
Use supplied facts when sufficient; authorize online research and competitor references only when needed.
Review sources, missing facts, and changing prices before publishing; approve a pinned CLI package before online execution.
anti_patterns: Inventing certifications, performance durations, sales figures, medical benefits, or return policies.
Copying competitor wording or treating competitor specifications as facts about the target product.
Using unsupported platform links as verified evidence or requesting unrestricted market scans.

faq.question: Do I need an API key?
faq.answer: No key is needed when you supply sufficient facts. Online product retrieval requires SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY and sufficient provider balance.

faq.question: Which platforms support online product retrieval?
faq.answer: Douyin and Xiaohongshu are supported. For other platforms, paste product facts rather than expecting automatic link retrieval.

faq.question: What does the draft include?
faq.answer: It includes opening copy, selling points, usage scenarios, specifications, and purchase FAQs, followed by source notes and missing information.

faq.question: Can it use competitor products?
faq.answer: Only when explicitly requested. It references up to three products and checks at most two details without copying wording or transferring claims.

faq.question: Does it publish listings or change accounts?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflow reads product information and drafts text; it does not publish listings or modify accounts.

faq.question: What should I check before running online commands?
faq.answer: Review and pin the external npm package before execution. The supplied examples use npx with automatic confirmation and a mutable latest version.
